mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_payroll_bonus (pay_month, bonus_type_cd, user_id, amount, taxable_yn, memo, status_cd, created_by) VALUES (#{payMonth}, #{bonusTypeCd}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{amount},0), COALESCE(#{taxableYn},'Y'), #{memo}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'PLANNED'), #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM gw_payroll_bonus WHERE bonus_id = #{bonusId} AND status_cd = 'PLANNED'
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_payroll_bonus SET status_cd = #{statusCd} WHERE bonus_id = #{bonusId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_payroll_bonus b JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE b.bonus_id = #{bonusId}

SELECT b.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_payroll_bonus b JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.pay_month = #{payMonth} AND b.bonus_type_cd = #{bonusTypeCd} ORDER BY b.pay_month DESC, d.dept_nm, u.name
SELECT * FROM gw_payroll_bonus WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pay_month = #{payMonth} AND status_cd = 'PLANNED' ORDER BY bonus_id
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_payroll_bonus SET status_cd = 'APPLIED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pay_month = #{payMonth} AND status_cd = 'PLANNED'
